rows.notes: The paper is a conceptual system proposal (block diagram, component diagram, use case, flow chart) for an IoT/ML/AR-drone farming system. It reports no measurements, experiments, survey data or model runs; the 'Results' section is a narrative summary with only a vague mention of 'encouraging feedback from testing phases' without any data. Hence not a primary study (Q1 no). Even if treated as primary, it contains nothing on UAV prescription spraying or pest suppression: the drone is proposed for fertilizer spreading, and pest/disease detection is mentioned only as a potential capability, not a tested result. No evidence on remote-sensing-based pest control.

notes: Full text appears complete (7-page conference paper). Literature survey section cites other work on drone thermal mapping and IoT irrigation; none of that counts as the study's own result.
